Description: "调整胶囊容器宽度至 385，完美容纳最长对齐文本。"
Instruction: "将 self.chart_overlay_badge 中的 width=345 调整为 width=385，留出充裕的物理对齐空间。"
ReplacementContent:
"        self.chart_overlay_badge = ft.Container(
            content=ft.Row(
                [
                    ft.Container(width=6, height=6, border_radius=3, bgcolor="#89b4fa"),
                    self.chart_range_text,
                ],
                spacing=6,
                alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.START,
            ),
            width=385, # 精准固定小胶囊宽度，彻底根治变宽弹跳抖动
            padding=ft.padding.symmetric(horizontal=10, vertical=6),
            bgcolor="#cc0c1117", # 深色高透毛玻璃
            border_radius=8,
            border=ft.border.all(1, "#30363d"),
            right=12,
            top=12,
            shadow=ft.BoxShadow(blur_radius=10, color="#80000000"),
        )"
